ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Getting Off to a Good Start

fullPassage:
High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time wisely to set yourself up for the future. Here are a few ways to do just that.
Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude. Whether you like lifting weights at the gym, jogging through the park, or riding a bicycle, establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know personally, such as a teacher or family member, or someone you admire, such as a famous athlete or artist. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their guidance. If it is someone you can't meet in person, you can study their actions and observe their strategies. What you learn from them will benefit you both during and long after high school.
These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time. For example, it's a good idea to finish surfing the Internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends. You can use your newly found time to connect with friends, family, and yourself. You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be when not glued to a screen.
Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a reminder of the person you used to be. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a more meaningful life.
The high school years can be overwhelming at times, but the challenge is there for a reason, and you don't have to be perfect every step of the way. During your high school days, have a great time trying out different things and discovering what works best for you. More importantly, however, don't forget to have fun along the way!

questions.passage: High school is the best time to (A)[spark / suppress] your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time (B)[wisely / wastefully] to set yourself up for the future. Here are a few ways to do just (C)[that / those].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 고등학교는 호기심과 열정에 불을 붙일 최고의 시간이다. 이 시간을 현명하게 써서 미래를 준비하라. 바로 그것을 하는 몇 가지 방법이 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ (A) spark: 호기심에 '불을 붙이다'. suppress(억누르다)는 반대. ✅ (B) wisely: 시간을 '현명하게' 사용. wastefully(낭비하며)는 반대. ✅ (C) that: 'do just that'은 앞 문장 전체를 가리키는 대명사.
det.tip: spark(불꽃을 일으키다) ↔ suppress(억누르다). wisely(현명하게) ↔ wastefully(낭비적으로).

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers (A)[countless / countable] benefits. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and (B)[fosters / frustrates] a positive attitude. Establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will (C)[strengthen / weaken] your body, mind, and spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 운동은 셀 수 없이 많은 이점을 제공한다. 자신감을 높이고 긍정적 태도를 기른다. 운동 루틴은 몸, 마음, 정신을 강화한다.
det.analysis: ✅ (A) countless: 이점이 '셀 수 없이 많다'. countable(셀 수 있는)은 맥락 불일치. ✅ (B) fosters: 긍정적 태도를 '기른다'. frustrates(좌절시키다)는 반대. ✅ (C) strengthen: 몸과 마음을 '강화'. weaken(약화)은 반대.
det.tip: foster: 양육하다, 기르다. 긍정적 태도를 '키운다'는 의미. countless = 셀 수 없는.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important (A)[decisions / divisions] you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you (B)[admire / ignore] can be an inspiration in itself. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their (C)[guidance / resistance].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 진로 선택은 가장 중요한 결정 중 하나다. 존경하는 사람들의 삶을 들여다보는 것은 그 자체로 영감이 된다. 사회적 인맥에서 누군가를 골라 직접 조언을 구할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ (A) decisions: 진로 선택은 중요한 '결정'. divisions(분열)은 맥락 불일치. ✅ (B) admire: '존경하는' 사람들. ignore(무시하다)는 반대. ✅ (C) guidance: 조언, 안내. resistance(저항)은 부적절.
det.tip: decision(결정) vs division(분열). guidance(안내/조언) vs resistance(저항).

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more ①<u>challenging</u> tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical ②<u>strength</u>; exercise also boosts ③<u>confidence</u> and fosters a ④<u>negative</u> attitude.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동은 셀 수 없이 많은 이점을 제공한다. 도전적인 과제를 완수할 수 있다. 체력에 국한되지 않고 자신감을 높이며 긍정적인(positive) 태도를 기른다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①challenging(도전적인): 원문 그대로, 적절. ✅ ②strength(힘): 원문 그대로, 적절. ✅ ③confidence(자신감): 원문 그대로, 적절. ❌ ④negative(부정적인): 원문은 positive(긍정적인). 운동의 이점이므로 긍정적 태도가 맞다.
det.tip: positive(긍정적인) ↔ negative(부정적인). 운동이 주는 이점 맥락에서 '긍정적'이 자연스럽다.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices ①<u>enrich</u> your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. You might be surprised at how much more ②<u>distracted</u> you can be when not glued to a screen. You can use your newly found time to ③<u>connect</u> with friends, family, and yourself. To make it easier to focus on important things, ④<u>set aside</u> your devices for some time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기기가 삶을 풍요롭게 하면 괜찮다. 화면에 붙어있지 않으면 얼마나 더 생산적인(productive)지 놀랄 것이다. distracted(산만한)는 반대 의미.
det.analysis: ✅ ①enrich(풍요롭게 하다): 원문 그대로, 적절. ❌ ②distracted(산만한): 원문은 productive(생산적인). 화면에서 벗어나면 '더 생산적'이라는 긍정적 결과. ✅ ③connect(연결하다): 원문 그대로, 적절. ✅ ④set aside(치워 두다): 원문 그대로, 적절.
det.tip: productive(생산적인) ↔ distracted(산만한). 기기에서 벗어남 → 집중력 상승 → 생산성 향상.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may ①<u>fade</u>. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a more ②<u>trivial</u> life. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to ③<u>reflect</u> on where you are and where you're heading. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a ④<u>reminder</u> of the person you used to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 관심사와 관점이 사라질 수 있다. 더 의미 있는(meaningful) 삶을 살 힘을 줄 수도 있다. trivial(하찮은)은 반대 의미.
det.analysis: ✅ ①fade(사라지다): 원문 그대로, 적절. ❌ ②trivial(하찮은): 원문은 meaningful(의미 있는). 삶에 힘을 주는 맥락이므로 '의미 있는'이 맞다. ✅ ③reflect(돌아보다): 원문 그대로, 적절. ✅ ④reminder(상기시키는 것): 원문 그대로, 적절.
det.tip: meaningful(의미 있는) ↔ trivial(하찮은). 편지가 주는 힘 → 더 의미 있는 삶.

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude. Whether you like lifting weights at the gym, jogging through the park, or riding a bicycle, establishing and sticking to an exercise __________ will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동 루틴을 만들고 지키면 몸, 마음, 정신이 강해진다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③routine: 'exercise routine(운동 루틴)'은 정기적인 운동 습관. ❌ ①obstacle(장애물): 문맥 불일치. ❌ ②restriction(제한): 부정적 뉘앙스. ❌ ④symptom(증상): 의학 용어로 부적절.
det.tip: routine: 일상적으로 하는 일련의 행동. 'establishing and sticking to a routine'은 '루틴을 만들고 고수하다'.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know personally, such as a teacher or family member. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사회적 인맥에서 누군가를 골라 직접 조언을 구할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①guidance(안내/조언): 롤 모델에게 직접 '조언'을 구하는 맥락. ❌ ②ignorance(무지): 맥락 반대. ❌ ③punishment(처벌): 완전 무관. ❌ ④departure(출발): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: guidance: 조언, 안내. 'ask for guidance'는 '조언을 구하다'라는 표현.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can __________ your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과도한 기술 의존은 정신 에너지를 고갈시킬 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②exhaust(고갈시키다): 과도한 의존이 에너지를 '소진'시킴. ❌ ①restore(회복하다): 반대 의미. ❌ ③multiply(증가시키다): 반대 방향. ❌ ④transfer(전달하다): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: exhaust: 고갈시키다, 지치게 하다. 'mental energy'와 자주 결합. excessive reliance → exhaust.

questions.stem: 다음 단어의 동의어로 가장 적절한 것은? explore

det.korean: explore: 탐험하다, 탐구하다
det.analysis: ✅ ③investigate(조사하다): explore과 '탐구하다'라는 의미 공유. ❌ ①abandon(버리다): 반대. ❌ ②restrict(제한하다): 무관. ❌ ④demolish(파괴하다): 무관.
det.tip: explore = investigate = 탐구하다. 새로운 것을 알아보다.

questions.stem: 다음 단어의 동의어로 가장 적절한 것은? overwhelming

det.korean: overwhelming: 압도적인, 감당하기 어려운
det.analysis: ✅ ④overpowering(압도적인): overwhelming과 의미 유사. ❌ ①relaxing(편안한): 반대. ❌ ②trivial(사소한): 반대. ❌ ③amusing(재미있는): 무관.
det.tip: overwhelming = overpowering = 압도적인. 감당하기 어려울 정도로 강한.

questions.stem: 다음 단어의 동의어로 가장 적절한 것은? excessive

det.korean: excessive: 과도한, 지나친
det.analysis: ✅ ②immoderate(과도한): excessive와 의미 동일. ❌ ①moderate(적당한): 반대. ❌ ③adequate(충분한): 다른 의미. ❌ ④minimal(최소한의): 반대.
det.tip: excessive = immoderate = 과도한. 적당한 수준을 넘어선.

questions.stem: 다음 단어의 반의어로 가장 적절한 것은? strengthen

det.korean: strengthen: 강화하다 ↔ weaken: 약화시키다
det.analysis: ✅ ①weaken(약화시키다): strengthen의 정반대. ❌ ②enhance(향상시키다): 유의어. ❌ ③reinforce(보강하다): 유의어. ❌ ④support(지지하다): 유사 방향.
det.tip: strengthen(강화) ↔ weaken(약화). 반의어 문제에서 유의어 함정 주의.

questions.stem: 다음 단어의 반의어로 가장 적절한 것은? fade

det.korean: fade: 사라지다, 희미해지다 ↔ intensify: 강해지다, 심화되다
det.analysis: ✅ ③intensify(강해지다): fade의 정반대. ❌ ①vanish(사라지다): 유의어. ❌ ②diminish(줄어들다): 유의어. ❌ ④decline(감소하다): 유의어.
det.tip: fade(희미해지다) ↔ intensify(강해지다). 나머지 3개는 모두 fade의 유의어 계열.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years <u>pass</u>, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>pass</u>의 문맥적 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?
ch: Could you pass me the salt?
Several months passed before she heard the news.
He managed to pass the final exam.
The bus will pass through the tunnel.

det.korean: 세월이 지나가다. '(시간이) 흐르다'의 의미.
det.analysis: ✅ ②passed(흘러가다): 시간이 경과하는 의미. ❌ ①pass(건네다): 물건 전달. ❌ ③pass(합격하다): 시험 통과. ❌ ④pass through(통과하다): 장소 이동.
det.tip: pass: 1) 건네다 2) (시간이) 지나다 3) 합격하다 4) 통과하다. 여기서는 'years pass' = 시간 경과.

questions.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who one looks up to and whose behavior serves as an example to follow"

det.korean: "본받고 따라야 할 행동의 본보기가 되는 사람" → role model(롤 모델)
det.analysis: ✅ ④role model: 본보기가 되는 사람. ❌ ①career(직업): 사람이 아님. ❌ ②strategy(전략): 행동 방식. ❌ ③perspective(관점): 시각.
det.tip: role model: 역할 모델. 존경하고 본받고 싶은 사람.

questions.passage: Whether you like lifting weights at the gym, jogging through the park, or riding a bicycle, [establish] and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 운동 루틴을 만들고(establishing) 고수하면 강해진다.
det.analysis: establish → establishing. 'and sticking to'와 병렬 구조이므로 동명사 establishing이 필요.
det.tip: 병렬 구조: establishing and sticking to. 둘 다 동명사.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, [excess] reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 과도한(excessive) 기술 의존은 정신 에너지를 소모시킨다.
det.analysis: excess → excessive. 명사 reliance를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 excessive.
det.tip: excess(명사/형용사) → excessive(형용사). 명사 앞 수식어 자리에는 형용사형 excessive.

questions.passage: High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time wisely to set yourself up for the future. Here are a few ways to do just that. Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers __________ benefits.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 규칙적 운동은 셀 수 없이 많은 이점을 제공한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④countless(셀 수 없이 많은): 운동의 이점이 매우 많다는 맥락. ❌ ①limited(제한된): 반대 의미. ❌ ②harmful(해로운): 이점과 모순. ❌ ③occasional(가끔의): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: countless: 무수히 많은. 운동의 다양한 이점을 강조하는 맥락.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a __________ of the person you used to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나이가 들면 이 편지가 과거의 자신을 상기시키는 것(reminder)이 될 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③reminder(상기시키는 것): 과거의 자신을 기억하게 해주는 역할. ❌ ①criticism(비판): 맥락 불일치. ❌ ②replacement(대체물): 무관. ❌ ④obstacle(장애물): 부정적 의미.
det.tip: reminder: 상기시키는 것. 'serve as a reminder of ~'는 '~을 상기시키는 역할을 하다'.
